subject.title: [Feature]: Bulk Approve All / Reject All in the Mac app pairing panel

question: Should the Mac pairing panel allow one-click approval of every visible pending pairing request, reversing the original one-decision-per-device policy?
rationale: Pairing is an authorization boundary and requester identity is unauthenticated before approval, so the convenience-versus-explicit-review tradeoff requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Allow both bulk actions
options.body: Accept Approve All and Reject All with mouse-only bulk approval routed through the existing per-request guards.

options.title: Allow Reject All only
options.body: Reduce queue-cleanup friction while retaining individual authorization for every approval.

options.title: Retain individual decisions
options.body: Preserve the original security UX and decline the linked implementation direction.

recommendation.title: Allow both bulk actions
recommendation.body: Accept Approve All and Reject All with mouse-only bulk approval routed through the existing per-request guards.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal across Mac pairing code and owns the original panel request, this follow-up issue, and its candidate PR.
